question: Does giving an AI trader a fixed technical-indicator summary, in addition to the same raw market data, change its trading behaviour and performance across BTC, ETH, and SOL?
classification: DESIGN PROPOSAL — NOT APPROVED FOR IMPLEMENTATION OR LAUNCH
instrument_wording: Synthetic USD-settled perpetual paper contract, marked and executed using Kraken {COIN}/USD spot-market OHLC data

market_data.fallback_for_committed_data: NONE — Kraken unavailable/incomplete/stale => PAIR_ABORTED with DATA_UNAVAILABLE
market_data.coinbase_role: health comparison, alerting reference, and test fixtures only; never supplies committed decisions, fills, exits, invalidation evaluation, or equity
market_data.completeness: exactly 72 contiguous closed hourly candles and 40 contiguous daily observations required; no silent omission
market_data.empty_interval_rule: OPTION B (pending mentor approval): a Kraken-omitted interval (no trades) is filled with a deterministic synthetic candle o=h=l=c=previous close, volume=0; synthetic count recorded in snapshot metadata and prompt-invisible; identical rule for all coins; gaps at the series end are staleness, not gaps => DATA_UNAVAILABLE
market_data.execution_price: close of last completed 1m candle at boundary T (P_T)
market_data.beyond_catchup: halt new decisions for the coin, preserve state, set NEEDS_REVIEW

common.sampling_parameters: temperature/top_p/top_k NOT SENT (rejected by sonnet-5 and opus-4-8; omitted for haiku for parity)
common.messages: single user message (round prompt); retry appends assistant tool_use + tool_result acknowledgment + fixed rejection message

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.thinking: parameter omitted (model runs without extended thinking; explicit disable not applicable pre-4.6)

request_payloads.twin_parity: Raw and TA requests for the same model are byte-identical except the user prompt text

atomic_unit: matched Raw/TA pair (same model, same coin); 9 independent pairs

accounts.max_leverage: 5.0 (validation limit — decisions above it are rejected, never clamped)
accounts.fee_rate: 0.0005 on every execution including stop/take-profit/liquidation fills

accounting.arithmetic: decimal.Decimal for equity, P&L, fees, notional, quantity, prices; full source precision internally
accounting.quantity_rounding: round DOWN to per-coin qty_decimals at execution
accounting.display_rounding: presentation only; never feeds back into engine values

invalidation.lifecycle: set once at open-from-flat or reversal; immutable while lifecycle open (hold/increase/reduce/partial exits); close or reversal ends it; no pre-trigger versioning
invalidation.trigger: inclusive comparison; first trigger latched permanently with timestamp+price+candle ref
invalidation.post_trigger: no forced exit; next-round prompt shows TRIGGERED block; behaviour recorded
invalidation.primary_discipline_metric: no longer exposed in the invalidated direction by the end of the account's next committed pair-round (stop, liquidation, reversal, or full close before that boundary qualifies); partial reductions reported descriptively, never as compliance

round_contract.duration: exactly 14 days = 336 scheduled boundaries from the predeclared start boundary
round_contract.no_mid_run_changes: no extension, shortening, coin/indicator/prompt/rule changes based on observed results; operational failures reported, not backfilled
round_contract.virtual_event_time: replay 1m to T -> freeze accounts at T -> freeze snapshot & P_T -> generate all 6 prompts -> collect/validate pair decisions -> apply committed pairs at P_T -> immediately replay 1m candles after T through latest completed candle -> apply stops/targets/liquidation/invalidation -> publish; wall-clock model latency is excluded from simulated market time

scheduler.missed_boundary: ROUND_SKIPPED for all unprocessed pairs; never executed retrospectively

persistence.code_branch: main pinned at approved launch tag; runtime never commits to it
persistence.runtime_branch: v1-runtime (state, prompts archive, logs, dashboard docs/)
persistence.integrity: every run verifies SHA-256 of code+prompts+schema+config against the launch manifest; mismatch => immediate halt
persistence.recorded_code_hash: the approved launch commit, not the runtime-data commit

primary_behavioural: abs target-size difference as % of equity
outcome_hierarchy.explicit_non_claim: V1 does not prove indicators improve profitability; performance results are descriptive (one instance per model-coin-arm; shared market regimes)

token_measurement: PENDING — count_tokens per model on 4 representative prompts (first-round raw/ta, mature raw/ta) during preflight; cost projection is provisional until then
